html:
Seven lotus flowers on the Han River during the Buddha’s birthday week symbolize the seven footsteps of Buddha, placed in the middle of the Han River. When night falls, the lotus flowers are lit up throughout the Buddha’s birthday, creating a sparkling scene in the heart of the city.

Seven lotus flowers are placed on the Han River

Seven lotus flowers are placed on the Han River right between the Dragon Bridge and the Han River Bridge, each lotus flower is about 20m apart, nearly 4m high, placed right in the middle of the Han River, anchored with floating activities to attract tourists to visit and take pictures.

This is one of the opening events for the Buddha’s birthday week in Da Nang city, and also for the upcoming anniversary of the birth of Buddha Shakyamuni…

The pink lotus flowers create a highlight for people and tourists, decorating seven pink lotus flowers on the Han River is a unique check-in point attracting people and tourists to visit Da Nang on the occasion of Buddha’s birthday.

The seven lotus flowers symbolize peace, praying for happiness and peace, lighting up seven lotus flowers on the Han River on the occasion of Vesak Buddha’s birthday not only has the meaning of Buddhist culture but also adds beauty to the Han River.

With the meaning of seven lotus flowers on the Han River, representing the seven pure steps of Buddha when he was born, many young people are very interested in watching the lotus flowers when traveling Da Nang and watching the beauty of the Han River when the whole city lights up.

The lotus flowers have a lighting system, when the night falls on the river, the lights create a solemn and sparkling scene in the heart of the coastal city.

Exciting festival events on the banks of the Han River in the summer

Festival events take place on both banks of the Han River, with 22 regular activities, 57 annual activities, the festival is arranged to suit the days of the week for the convenience of people and tourists to attend.

From February to September, every Saturday and Sunday in Da Nang, there will be many exciting activities such as singing Bai Choi on Friday evenings, on the 2nd and 4th weeks of every month, along with music concerts, the first Saturday of summer will have a Music Performance Cluster.

At the sidewalk area of ​​Nhu Nguyet Street, the landscape floor of the park on the east bank of Tran Thi Ly Bridge, Bach Dang walking street, there are film screening programs on the banks of the Han River, street music, the art program “music and life”, mobile libraries… all will bring visitors the most enjoyable vacation.

In addition, when taking a summer tour Da Nang, visitors can also participate in street dances, street music, folk dances… or cultural reading festivals, film screenings… taking place alternately on both banks of the Han River, Bach Dang and Tran Hung Dao streets.

In addition, on the banks of the Han River, there are many big festival programs throughout the year, along with many interesting games that will bring visitors the most enjoyable vacation, especially when night falls, visitors can take a walk to visit and watch the Dragon Bridge breathe fire and water on weekends.

So come to Da Nang once, not only to admire the beauty, or join in the festival atmosphere taking place on the banks of the Han River, but also visit the famous sights, or experience the cable car on Ba Na mountain, or dive to see coral at Son Tra peninsula, take a canoe to Cu Lao Cham island… and many other interesting programs are waiting for visitors to discover.
